title: Direct object pronouns
goal: Replace a noun with le, la, l' or les to avoid repeating it, and put the pronoun in the right place: before the verb, in negative sentences and with aller + infinitive.

items.en: direct object pronouns: it, them (replacing a noun)

drills.explain: [[le chandail]] is masculine → [[le]], placed **before** the verb.

drills.en: The red toque? I'm buying it.

drills.prompt: The boots? I'm trying them on.
drills.explain: [[les bottes]] → [[les]], before the verb: [[je les essaie]].

items.fr: ne + le / la / les + verbe + pas
items.en: pronoun position in a negative sentence

drills.text: Le manteau noir ? Non, je ne ___ prends pas.
drills.en: The black coat? No, I'm not taking it.
drills.explain: The pronoun stays glued to the verb, inside [[ne… pas]]: [[je ne le prends pas]].

options: La chemise ? Je ne la veux pas.
La chemise ? Je la ne veux pas.
La chemise ? Je ne veux la pas.

drills.prompt: The pants? I don't like them. (le pantalon)
accept: Le pantalon ? Je ne l'aime pas.
drills.explain: [[le pantalon]] is singular in French → [[le]] → [[l']] before [[aime]]: [[je ne l'aime pas]].

items.en: pronoun position with aller + infinitive (futur proche)

drills.text: Le pantalon gris ? Je vais ___ essayer.
drills.en: The grey pants? I'm going to try them on.
drills.explain: With two verbs, the pronoun goes before the **infinitive**: [[je vais l'essayer]] ([[le]] → [[l']] before a vowel).

drills.prompt: “The red dress? I'm going to take it.”
options: La robe rouge ? Je vais la prendre.
La robe rouge ? Je la vais prendre.
La robe rouge ? Je vais prendre la.
drills.explain: The pronoun goes with the verb it belongs to: you *take* the dress → [[la prendre]].

drills.text: Les bottes ? Je ne vais pas ___ acheter.
drills.en: The boots? I'm not going to buy them.
drills.explain: Negation around [[aller]], pronoun before the infinitive: [[je ne vais pas les acheter]].

items.note: j'essaie or j'essaye: both are correct.

example.en: Can I try on this sweater?

example.en: The fitting rooms are at the back, on the right.

items.note: Québec word. In France: un pull. Plural: des chandails.
Québec word. In France: un bonnet.

example.fr: En hiver, je porte toujours une tuque.
example.en: In winter, I always wear a toque.

items.note: Singular in French: un pantalon = a pair of pants.

items.en: What colour would you like it in? (a salesperson, formal)

steps.title: Shopping for winter clothes
steps.intro: Olivier needs warm clothes for his first Montréal winter. Lucie works in a clothing store downtown.

blocks.title: In a clothing store
blocks.context: Listen for the little words [[le]], [[la]], [[l']] and [[les]] before the verbs. What do they replace?

lines.speaker: Olivier
lines.fr: Oui, je cherche un chandail chaud. J'aime bien le chandail bleu, dans la vitrine.
lines.en: Yes, I'm looking for a warm sweater. I quite like the blue sweater in the window.

lines.speaker: Lucie
lines.fr: Ah, il est en laine, il est très chaud. Je l'ai aussi en vert et en gris. Vous le voulez en quelle couleur ?
lines.en: Ah, it's wool, it's very warm. I also have it in green and grey. What colour would you like it in?

lines.speaker: Olivier
lines.fr: En bleu, je pense. Je peux l'essayer ?
lines.en: In blue, I think. Can I try it on?

lines.speaker: Lucie
lines.fr: Bien sûr. Les cabines d'essayage sont au fond, à droite. Et les tuques, là-bas, elles sont en solde aujourd'hui.
lines.en: Of course. The fitting rooms are at the back, on the right. And the toques over there are on sale today.

lines.speaker: Olivier
lines.fr: Super, je vais les regarder après.
lines.en: Great, I'll look at them afterwards.

lines.speaker: Olivier
lines.fr: Il est parfait. Je le prends ! Et cette tuque rouge, je l'adore. Je la prends aussi.
lines.en: It's perfect. I'll take it! And this red toque, I love it. I'll take it too.

lines.speaker: Lucie
lines.fr: Et le pantalon noir ? Vous ne l'essayez pas ?
lines.en: And the black pants? Aren't you trying them on?

lines.speaker: Olivier
lines.fr: Non, je ne le prends pas aujourd'hui. Il est un peu trop cher pour moi. Je vais l'acheter pendant les soldes !
lines.en: No, I'm not taking them today. They're a bit too expensive for me. I'll buy them during the sales!

lines.speaker: Lucie
lines.fr: Bonne idée. Vous pouvez payer à la caisse, juste là.
lines.en: Good idea. You can pay at the cash, right there.

blocks.prompt: In “Je la prends aussi”, what does la replace?
blocks.explain: Olivier has just said [[cette tuque rouge, je l'adore]]. [[La]] refers back to [[la tuque]] so he doesn't repeat it.

options: The blue sweater and the red toque
The blue sweater and the black pants
blocks.explain: [[Je le prends]] (the sweater), [[je la prends aussi]] (the toque). The pants: [[je ne le prends pas aujourd'hui]].

blocks.title: Why use a pronoun?
blocks.body:
Once you've named a thing, you don't repeat it: you replace it with a short word, like English *it* and *them*.

[[Le chandail bleu ? Je **le** prends.]] = The blue sweater? I'll take **it**.

These pronouns replace a **direct object**: a thing or person that comes right after the verb, with no preposition ([[je prends **le chandail**]], [[je regarde **les tuques**]]).

blocks.title: Which pronoun?
head: The noun
Pronoun
Example
rows: Je l'essaie. Je l'achète. Je l'aime.
blocks.note: The pronoun has the gender and number of the **noun in French**, not in English: [[le pantalon]] → [[le]] (*them* in English!), [[la chemise]] → [[la]].

blocks.title: Where does it go?
head: Sentence type
Position
Example
rows: Vous le voulez en bleu ? Je peux l'essayer ?
Je vais l'acheter. Je vais les regarder.
Je peux l'essayer ? Je dois les rapporter.
blocks.note: **Rule of thumb:** the pronoun goes right **before the verb that does the action to it**. You *try on* the sweater → [[l'essayer]].

blocks.body:
- **English order:** [[Je prends le]] ✗ → [[Je le prends]]. The pronoun goes **before** the verb.
- **Negation:** [[Je le ne prends pas]] ✗ and [[Je ne prends le pas]] ✗ → [[Je ne le prends pas]].
- **With aller:** [[Je le vais prendre]] ✗ → [[Je vais le prendre]].
- **Gender from French:** *the pants? I'll take them* → [[Je **le** prends]] ([[le pantalon]] is singular).
- **Elision:** [[Je le aime]] ✗ → [[Je l'aime]]. But never elide [[les]]: [[Je les aime]] (with a z sound).

blocks.title: A preview: the pronoun in the passé composé
blocks.body: In the passé composé, the pronoun goes **before avoir**: [[Je l'ai acheté hier.]] (I bought it yesterday.) In writing, the participle then agrees with the pronoun: [[La tuque ? Je l'ai achetée.]] [[Les bottes ? Je les ai achetées.]] You usually can't hear it, so for now, just recognize it.

examples.fr: Le chandail ? Je l'ai acheté au centre-ville.
examples.en: The sweater? I bought it downtown.

examples.fr: Les bottes ? Je les ai achetées pendant les soldes.
examples.en: The boots? I bought them during the sales.

blocks.title: Clothes words and “j'aime ça”
blocks.body:
- Québec winter vocabulary: [[une tuque]] (France: *un bonnet*), [[un chandail]] (France: *un pull*), [[des mitaines]] (mittens; France: *des moufles*), [[un manteau d'hiver]], [[des bottes d'hiver]], [[un cache-cou]] (neck warmer).
- With [[aimer]] and a thing in general, people often say [[j'aime ça]] instead of a pronoun: [[Le chocolat ? J'aime ça !]] This is very common in Québec. [[Je l'aime]] tends to be for a specific item or a person: [[Cette tuque, je l'adore !]]
- In a store, the checkout is [[la caisse]], and the window display is [[la vitrine]] (the same words in France and Québec).

[[le]] and [[les]] sound different: [[le]] is a soft *luh*, [[les]] is *lé*. Before a vowel, [[les]] links with a **z** sound: [[je les essaie]] sounds like *jlé-zéssè*.

In fast speech, [[je le]] often loses its first vowel: [[je le prends]] sounds like *j'le prends*.

examples.fr: Je le prends. Je les prends.
examples.en: I'll take it. I'll take them.

options: La robe ? Je ne vais pas l'acheter.
La robe ? Je ne la vais pas acheter.

blocks.prompt: You're in a clothing store. Talk to the salesperson about three items: ask to try one on, say you'll take one and say you won't take the other (with a reason). Use pronouns instead of repeating the nouns.
checklist: Je ne le / la / les prends pas, parce que…
One sentence with aller + pronoun + infinitive

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Bonjour ! Je cherche des mitaines et une tuque. J'aime bien ces mitaines grises. Je peux les essayer ? … Elles sont parfaites, je les prends. Et la tuque verte ? Non, je ne la prends pas : elle est un peu trop chère. Le manteau rouge, dans la vitrine, je vais l'essayer la semaine prochaine. Merci !
models.en: Hello! I'm looking for mittens and a toque. I quite like these grey mittens. Can I try them on? … They're perfect, I'll take them. And the green toque? No, I won't take it: it's a bit too expensive. The red coat in the window, I'll try it on next week. Thank you!

blocks.prompt: Write a message to a friend about your shopping trip: what you saw, what you tried on, what you bought or didn't buy, and what you're going to buy later. Use at least three pronouns.

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Salut Nguyen ! Aujourd'hui, j'ai magasiné au centre-ville. J'ai vu un manteau d'hiver super chaud, mais il est très cher. Je l'ai essayé, et il est plus confortable que mon vieux manteau ! Je ne le prends pas tout de suite : je vais l'acheter pendant les soldes. Par contre, j'ai trouvé des bottes en solde. Je les adore ! À bientôt, Olivier
models.en: Hi Nguyen! Today I went shopping downtown. I saw a super warm winter coat, but it's very expensive. I tried it on, and it's more comfortable than my old coat! I'm not taking it right away: I'll buy it during the sales. On the other hand, I found some boots on sale. I love them! See you soon, Olivier

summary:
- Replace a noun with [[le]], [[la]], [[l']] or [[les]]: [[Le chandail ? Je le prends.]]
- Put the pronoun before the verb, inside [[ne… pas]]: [[Je ne la prends pas.]]
- With two verbs, put it before the infinitive: [[Je vais l'essayer.]] [[Je peux les essayer ?]]
- Shop for clothes: [[un chandail]], [[une tuque]], [[un pantalon]], [[la cabine d'essayage]]
